eventDetail.scope: GEAI 2026 is poised to emerge as a cornerstone international hub dedicated to advancing green energy initiatives and AI-powered energy technologies. It will gather leading experts, researchers, and industry practitioners from across the globe to showcase groundbreaking innovations in core domains, including machine learning and deep learning algorithms, AI-based renewable energy modeling and control, green energy and renewable energy systems, photovoltaic power generation and solar energy forecasting, wind farm layout optimization and power forecasting, intelligent power and energy systems, intelligent forecasting and time series analysis for industrial power systems, and industrial microgrid renewable energy integration and intelligent control. Beyond serving as a forum for idea exchange, GEAI 2026 is designed to catalyze synergistic cooperation among global stakeholders and pave the way for actionable, sustainable solutions to address the pressing energy challenges.
